description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the Recent Sequence Ratio (%) and two metrics: Perplexity and GPU Mem. Ratio (%). The x-axis represents the Recent Sequence Ratio (%), plotted on a linear scale ranging from 10 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 20. The plot features two y-axes: the left y-axis represents Perplexity on a linear scale ranging from 4.2 to 4.7 with tick marks at intervals of 0.1, while the right y-axis represents the GPU Mem. Ratio (%) on a linear scale ranging from 40 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 10. The "Perplexity" data is represented by a solid orange line with circular markers, corresponding to the left y-axis. It begins at a value of approximately 4.59 at an x-value of 10, declines to 4.3 at x=40, rises slightly to 4.34 at x=60, drops to 4.29 at x=70, increases to 4.39 at x=90, and ends at 4.38 at x=100. A reference line for "Full Cache PPL" is shown as a dashed dark red line without markers, remaining constant at approximately 4.38 on the left y-axis across the entire x-axis range. The "GPU Mem. Ratio" data is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, corresponding to the right y-axis. It starts at approximately 40 at x=10, increases gradually to 48 at x=70, rises to 55 at x=80, experiences a sharp increase to 98 at x=90, and ends at 100 at x=100. Finally, a reference line for "Full Cache GPU Mem." is depicted as a dashed blue line without markers, remaining constant at 100 on the right y-axis across the entire x-axis range.
